info.title: Easee Cloud API
info.description: OpenAPI Definitions for Easee Cloud APIs.

tags.name: Account
tags.description: Sign in, refresh tokens and manage the logged-in account.

tags.name: State
tags.description: Read the active scheduling state of a charger.

tags.name: Daily schedule
tags.description: Charge at the same times every day.

tags.name: Weekly schedule
tags.description: Charge at set times for each day of the week.

tags.name: Cloud OCPP
tags.description: Configure Cloud OCPP settings and custom endpoints for operators.

tags.name: Energy Reporting
tags.description: Lifetime energy measurements for chargers, hourly to yearly.

tags.name: Resources
